# meshstack_workspace (Data Source)

Read a single workspace by identifier. Without `metadata.name`, it reads the workspace the provider acts in, which the provider's `workspace` or `MESHSTACK_WORKSPACE` names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_workspace" "example" {
  metadata = {
    name = "my-workspace"
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Omit metadata.name to read the workspace that the provider acts in.
provider "meshstack" {
  workspace = "my-workspace"
}

data "meshstack_workspace" "this" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))

### Read-Only

- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to this workspace, can be used as `target_ref` in building block resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ref))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Workspace identifier. Defaults to the workspace the provider acts in.

Read-Only:

- `created_on` (String) Creation date of the workspace.
- `deleted_on` (String) Deletion date of the workspace.
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Tags of `meshWorkspace`.


<a id="nestedatt--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshWorkspace`.
- `name` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of `meshWorkspace`.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the workspace.
- `platform_builder_access_enabled` (Boolean) When enabled, you can open the platform builder in meshPanel while visiting this workspace.
